text: Sorrow of Cathay

Qing Bao Tian Zun's schemes have now succeeded, and the great Bastion forged by the Dragon Emperor has collapsed. Chaos lurks beyond, the Dragon's children war among themselves within, and rebellions rise throughout the Empire. General Han Peng still holds Po Mei alone, while General Fu must break through the encircling Chaos as swiftly as possible, restore the Great Bastion, sweep away the taint of evil, and return peace to Cathay.
The Great Bastion Reclaimed

The Great Bastion has finally been fully reclaimed, and the great enemy of the north will once again face this unbreakable defensive line.\\nThe Torchbearer's Resolve mechanic will now be enabled, granting the Frontier Guard faction different faction-wide bonuses depending on the current stage of the Chaos Threat.
Scion of Nan Gau

The fortress of the Great Bastion now stands complete, and the war is about to enter its next phase. Travel-worn, the Scion of Nan Gau arrives with her retinue. You sharply notice her gaze fall upon you—the gaze one gives to a finely-crafted weapon. You have become just what she hoped for: a keen blade to be cast against the north beyond the Bastion.
Undercurrents Stir

People gather to whisper among themselves, wondering why the army under General Fu Yuanshan, instead of confronting the great enemy of Chaos, keeps meddling in Cathay's internal affairs.\\n(Occupying more than 10 settlements within Cathay will incur a mild penalty to upkeep and construction costs.)
Ambition Laid Bare

Everyone is discussing how the widely-revered General Fu Yuanshan will demonstrate his strength to Cathay, and how he will prove his loyalty.\\n(Occupying more than 20 settlements within Cathay will incur a severe penalty to upkeep and construction costs. To remove this penalty, you must construct the [Celestial Tower] landmark at Blood Wind Keep in the Chaos Wastes.)
The Torchbearer's Resolve

After ages beyond mortal reckoning, the Celestial Tower blazes anew, casting the Dragon Emperor's glory across the Chaos Wastes.\\n(Fu Yuanshan has now proven his loyalty to the people of Cathay through his actions. Henceforth, involvement in Cathay's internal affairs will no longer incur penalties to upkeep and construction costs.)
The Rangers Return

Ever since the fall of Chi Lei, the Wall Rangers who escaped the city have harried the Chaos garrison there day and night, hoping to reclaim Chi Lei. Now that the army has retaken Chi Lei, the Rangers rightfully return to their post.
Introducing The Torchbearer's Resolve

The Torchbearer's Resolve is a unique mechanic of the Frontier Guard faction. At the start of each turn, it grants different status bonuses depending on the current stage of the Chaos Threat. When Chaos Threat is low, Order and Growth bonuses are gained; when Chaos Threat is high, a series of military bonuses are gained instead.\\nNote: This mechanic is only enabled once all three passes of the Great Bastion are held by Cathayan factions.
Standing Down
The threat of Chaos remains distant; now is the time to rest and recuperate.\\nChaos Threat: 0~25
Mustering Arms
The threat of Chaos draws near, and all soldiers must be mobilized.\\nChaos Threat: 26~75
Standing Ready
The threat of Chaos looms close at hand. Form ranks and await the coming foe.\\nChaos Threat: 75~99
Guarding the Wall with One's Own Body
The threat of Chaos has arrived. Now only one's own body can defend the Great Bastion.\\nChaos Threat: 100
The Great Bastion Changes Hands
The Great Bastion is the northern gateway of Cathay, and must never fall into the hands of another. Even should it come to the sword, it must be reclaimed!
Mound of Bleached Bones

For days, thunderous roars echoed across the Chaos Wastes, yet none knew for certain what transpired deep within the Great Bastion. All that was known was that, days later, a towering mound built from Kurgan skulls appeared beyond the Bastion.
The Dragon General Returns

Fu Yuanshan is a divine weapon meticulously forged by Miao Ying, intended to face Cathay's ever-present great enemy—honed on the whetstone of hatred, consecrated with blood. This divine weapon is destined to display its edge in the north beyond the Great Bastion.\\n[[col:green]]He has now joined your recruitment pool—use him well.[[/col]]
